about_the_game:
Hanno is a visually captivating action-adventure game that blends fluid combat, story-driven exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

 

Set in the fictional world of Ashar, the player takes on the role of Vimal, an orphaned teenager from a small village who stumbles upon Hanno – an unusual white baby elephant – alone and wounded in the forest. As Vimal, players must uncover the mystery behind Hanno, while battling the Asuras, malevolent creatures that have suddenly corrupted the boy’s world.

An elephantastic bond

Experience the wonder of having a baby elephant companion: bond with Hanno and use his magical powers in combat and puzzle-solving.

The Asuras

Face fantastical foes, each with unique attack patterns and vulnerabilities - yet all united by a common goal - as you prepare for unexpected challenges in every battle.

Seize or save enemies and upgrade your skills across two paths.

Ashar

Explore the lush tropical regions, ancient forests and sacred temples of Ashar, filled with secrets and collectibles. Uncover a forgotten legend, for it holds the key to the truth.

Find items to customize Hanno.

The boy and the elephant

Immerse yourself in a heartfelt tale of growth, courage, and discovery – one that will stay with you long after it ends.

name: Hanno
short_description: Fate brings together Hanno, an unusual baby elephant, and Vimal, an orphaned teenager, as they face a supernatural menace that threatens their world. They will bond as friends, fight and explore as one, and uncover the true cost of loyalty in this stunning and heartfelt action-adventure game.

English*, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
